import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb

np.random.seed(42)

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Exclude f_27 due to high cardinality
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target", "f_27"]]

print(f"Total features: {len(feature_cols)}")
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Identify numeric columns for interaction creation with f_29 and f_30
numeric_cols = [
    col
    for col in feature_cols
    if col
    in [
        "f_00",
        "f_01",
        "f_02",
        "f_03",
        "f_04",
        "f_05",
        "f_06",
        "f_19",
        "f_20",
        "f_21",
        "f_22",
        "f_23",
        "f_24",
        "f_25",
        "f_26",
        "f_28",
    ]
]
print(f"Selected numeric columns for interaction: {len(numeric_cols)}")

# Create interaction features: f_29 and f_30 interacted with selected numeric features
interaction_cols = []
for base_col in ["f_29", "f_30"]:
    for num_col in numeric_cols:
        if base_col not in num_col and num_col != base_col:
            interaction_col = f"{base_col}_{num_col}"
            interaction_cols.append(interaction_col)
print(f"Created {len(interaction_cols)} interaction features")

# Add interaction columns to both train and test
train_interactions = pd.DataFrame(index=train_df.index)
for base_col in ["f_29", "f_30"]:
    for num_col in numeric_cols:
        if base_col not in num_col and num_col != base_col:
            train_interactions[f"{base_col}_{num_col}"] = (
                train_df[base_col] * train_df[num_col]
            )

test_interactions = pd.DataFrame(index=test_df.index)
for base_col in ["f_29", "f_30"]:
    for num_col in numeric_cols:
        if base_col not in num_col and num_col != base_col:
            test_interactions[f"{base_col}_{num_col}"] = (
                test_df[base_col] * test_df[num_col]
            )

# Combine features - base features + interaction features
X_train_base = train_df[feature_cols]
X_test_base = test_df[feature_cols]

X_train = pd.concat([X_train_base, train_interactions], axis=1)
X_test = pd.concat([X_test_base, test_interactions], axis=1)

feature_cols = list(X_train.columns)

print(f"Total features after interaction: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Create hold-out validation split
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train,
    train_df["target"],
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=train_df["target"],
    random_state=42,
)

test_ids = test_df["id"]
X_test_final = X_test

# Check categorical columns (should still be none as all features are numeric)
cat_cols = [col for col in feature_cols if X_train[col].dtype in ["object", "category"]]
print(f"Categorical columns found: {cat_cols}")

# Optimized parameters from previous best solution
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 50,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "force_row_wise": True,
}

categorical_features = cat_cols if len(cat_cols) > 0 else None

print("Creating datasets...")
train_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train,
    label=y_train,
    feature_name=feature_cols,
    categorical_feature=categorical_features,
)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val,
    label=y_val,
    reference=train_data,
    feature_name=feature_cols,
    categorical_feature=categorical_features,
)

print("Training model...")
callbacks = [
    lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False),
]

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    valid_names=["validation"],
    callbacks=callbacks,
)

print("Evaluating on validation set...")
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

print("Generating predictions on test set...")
test_pred = model.predict(X_test_final, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids.values, "target": test_pred})

print(f"Saving submission to ./submission/submission.csv")
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved successfully with {len(submission)} rows")

print("\nSubmission preview:")
print(submission.head())
print(f"\nValidation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.6f}")
